title: Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use the school timetable and clubs as examples of the categories.

skills.key_step: The child names the categories (visual arts and crafts, music, performing arts, physical education and sports) and how they work together.
steps: Find links: music with dance, art with costume.

board.do: A dance with drums and costumes.
Music, performing arts and visual arts.

misconceptions.ask: How do music and dance relate?
misconceptions.repair: Watch a folk dance: name the music, the movement and the costume, three categories in one.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a category of Creative Arts and Sports?
misconceptions.repair: Read the subject name aloud: Creative Arts and Sports. List what PE adds.
Sort ten activities into visual arts, performing arts and sports with the reason for each.

misconceptions.ask: Which category does drama belong to?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what the performer does: tells a story (performing arts) or competes (sport).

checks.question: Give one way music and sport work together.
checks.answer: any, such as a band at sports day or rhythm in aerobics
